privacy_body.p: Despacho Bonsai is the product practice of Daniel Vásquez, based in Mexico City. This policy covers this website.

When you book a call, the booking form sends your name, email and anything you choose to tell us to Cal.com, which schedules the call. We also use Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics to understand which pages are useful, which sets analytics cookies.

The chat in the corner of every page is an AI assistant. What you type is sent to Google's Gemini service on Google Cloud to write the reply, and the conversation is stored on Google Cloud so Daniel can read it and follow up. If you leave a message, your name, email and note go to Daniel. Please don't share sensitive information in the chat.
Only to reply to you, prepare and hold the call you booked, and improve this website. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for advertising. Ever.
You can ask us to see, correct or delete what we hold about you at any time, and you can block analytics cookies in your browser without losing access to anything on this site.

terms_body.p: This site describes Despacho Bonsai's services and lets you book a call. You may use it for that purpose. Its content is ours unless stated otherwise.
Any paid work is governed by a separate written scope and agreement, signed before the work starts. Nothing on this site is a binding offer; prices shown are starting points.
We keep this site accurate, but it is provided as is. Links to other sites, including the products we build, are governed by those sites' own terms.

cookies_body.p: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics set cookies that tell us which pages are visited and how people move through the site.
The booking calendar is provided by Cal.com and may set the cookies it needs to schedule your call.
You can block or delete these cookies in your browser at any time. Everything on this site keeps working without them.
